description:
Put a project's working copy back the way one of its releases (saved versions) had it: components added since are removed, removed ones come back, values and scripts go back to that version (each script as a new version on top of the current one), and the name. The user sees it at once in any R3 tab that has the project open. Only when the user asked for it.

Two steps: call it WITHOUT planToken first; it changes nothing and says what restoring would change, with a planToken. Tell the user, and only if they agree call it again with that planToken. If the project changed in between, nothing is changed and the new plan comes back.

The whole restore is ONE change of yours: r3_editor_undo takes it back. It never changes which release is LIVE (what the public URL shows): that is r3_release_rollback. Take the release number from r3_release_list. Needs project:write (and code:write when scripts change).

planToken.description: The planToken the first call answered; only when the user agreed to that plan.

releaseNumber.description: The release to restore the working copy to (r3_release_list).

name: r3_release_restore

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Restore a project to a saved version
